# Barlow Semi Condensed – third-party license

Raffica embeds the font **Barlow Semi Condensed** SemiBold (600) for the field-code badges of the apps. It lies in `src/Raffica.Shell/Assets/Fonts/` and is embedded in `Raffica.Shell`.

## Source and license

- Project: https://github.com/jpt/barlow, taken from https://github.com/google/fonts at commit `2fe1e8c6b137fb13041a7cfca6fdcd8a910ea4dc` (`ofl/barlowsemicondensed/BarlowSemiCondensed-SemiBold.ttf`)
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, text in [OFL.txt](OFL.txt) (Copyright 2017 The Barlow Project Authors).
- The file is the upstream file, unchanged. Its SHA-256 is in `src/Raffica.Shell/Assets/Fonts/SOURCES.md`.
